name: AI Mode Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Configure and control Falcon Player (FPP) using natural language. Link OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Grok, OpenRouter, Azure, Ollama (local, not installed by default), OpenCode Console (opencode.ai, send prompts, chat history and FPP context to it for inference) or an OpenCode server you run yourself (same data goes to your server, which may forward it to other providers). Create playlists, schedules, channel outputs and settings from typed prompts with an assistant that shows tool calls for approval.

privacy.other: API keys are stored in plugindata with 0600 and are never logged. Chat, Test Connection and model-list routes send your prompt, chat history and FPP context to the provider you selected, only when you use those features; Save, Execute, conversation and history routes change or delete your own data, and Flag FPPD Restart asks FPP to restart. These routes are reached exactly like FPP's own pages and have no separate login, so they check that a browser request came from the same FPP host. The OpenCode server option may itself forward your prompts to whichever model provider that server is configured with. Updates, reinstalls and uninstalls are left to FPP's Plugin Manager.
